title: Tiny Goblin Academy Topdown Floor Tilesheets Manifest
scope: Six 8x8 full-cell topdown ground/floor tilesheets. Road/path overlay sheet is intentionally excluded.
runtimeDoctrine: Tile labels are draft semantic names for cataloging and generator vocabulary.
These names do not approve collision, pathfinding, hazard, portal, speed, trigger, loot, or other gameplay behavior.
All listed tiles are treated as full-cell ground/floor tiles unless later metadata overrides them.
Marker/rune/arrow/glow-looking tiles are visual-only until explicitly runtime-approved.

stone slabs, broken dungeon floor, moss, carved floor markers
wood plank floors, parquet, rugs, stone/wood threshold variants
